name: Technical health
checks: robots.txt exists, returns status 200 and blocks no page that is meant to rank
robots.txt names the location of the XML sitemap
An XML sitemap exists, is valid and returns status 200
The sitemap lists every indexable page and nothing else
The sitemap contains no redirected, broken, noindexed or canonicalised-away URLs
Sitemap last-modified dates are real and change only when the page changes
The sitemap is submitted in Google Search Console and read without errors
The sitemap is submitted in Bing Webmaster Tools and read without errors
The page is indexable: no noindex in the meta robots tag or the X-Robots-Tag header
The page has exactly one canonical tag and it points to itself
The canonical URL is absolute, returns status 200 and is itself indexable
The page is indexed in Google, confirmed by URL inspection in Search Console
The page is indexed in Bing, confirmed in Bing Webmaster Tools
Only one host version is live: http, https, www and non-www all reach it in a single 301
Trailing-slash and upper/lower-case variants of a URL resolve to one address
No redirect chain is longer than one hop
Permanent moves use a 301 or 308, never a 302 or a meta refresh
No internal link points to a URL that redirects
No internal link returns a 4xx error
No page returns a 5xx error during a full crawl
Missing pages return a true 404 status with a helpful 404 page, and no soft 404s exist
No duplicate pages: the same content is not reachable at more than one indexable URL
URL parameters for tracking, sorting and filtering do not create indexable duplicates
Paginated series are crawlable and each page in the series is self-canonical
The main content is in the HTML Google receives and does not depend on a click or scroll to appear
The CSS and JavaScript needed to render pages are not blocked from crawlers
Search Console shows no unresolved page-indexing errors for pages meant to rank
Search Console shows no manual action and no security issue
Search Console crawl stats show no rise in errors and no host problems
The URL is lowercase, hyphenated, readable and free of session IDs
Language and region tags (hreflang), where used, are valid and reciprocal
Staging and test copies of the site are blocked from indexing
IndexNow is set up so Bing and other engines learn of changes at once
Crawl data or server logs confirm Googlebot reached every key page in the last 30 days

name: Speed and stability
checks: Largest Contentful Paint is 2.5 seconds or less on mobile
Largest Contentful Paint is 2.5 seconds or less on desktop
Interaction to Next Paint is 200 milliseconds or less on mobile
Interaction to Next Paint is 200 milliseconds or less on desktop
Cumulative Layout Shift is 0.1 or less on mobile
Cumulative Layout Shift is 0.1 or less on desktop
The site passes the Core Web Vitals assessment in Search Console on real-user data
Server response time (time to first byte) is 800 milliseconds or less
PageSpeed Insights performance score is 80 or higher on mobile
PageSpeed Insights performance score is 90 or higher on desktop
Total page weight on first load is under 2 MB
The largest above-the-fold element is prioritised and never lazy-loaded
Images below the fold are lazy-loaded
Images are served in a modern format such as WebP or AVIF
No image is delivered larger than the size it is displayed at
Images, videos and embeds reserve their space so nothing shifts while loading
No script in the page head blocks rendering: scripts are deferred or asynchronous
No single third-party script blocks the main thread for more than 250 milliseconds
Text files are compressed with Brotli or gzip
Static files are cached with long cache lifetimes
A content delivery network serves static files
Fonts are limited in number, preloaded and show fallback text while loading
Uptime is monitored and was 99.9% or better over the last 30 days

name: Mobile experience
checks: The viewport tag is set so the page fits the screen width
No horizontal scrolling at a 390-pixel phone width
The layout holds together at a 768-pixel tablet width
Body text is at least 16 pixels and readable without zooming
Buttons and links are at least 48 pixels tall with space between them
The mobile menu opens, closes and reaches every main section
Forms are usable on a phone: correct keyboard per field, visible labels, working autofill
No pop-up or overlay covers the content on arrival
Mobile and desktop versions carry the same content, headings, links and structured data
The primary call to action is visible on a phone without scrolling
Sticky bars and buttons never cover content or other buttons
Tables and wide content stack or scroll inside their own container
Addresses open in maps and email addresses open a new message

name: Security
checks: The security certificate is valid and does not expire within 30 days
Every http request redirects to https
The page loads no insecure (http) images, scripts or styles
Standard security headers are set: content security policy, content-type options, frame protection, referrer policy
The CMS, theme and plugins run current, supported versions
No backup files, repository folders, environment files, debug logs or open directory listings are exposed
The admin login is protected: no default address or user, attempts limited, two-factor on
Google Safe Browsing and blocklist checks show no malware or warnings
Forms are protected against spam and injection, and backups run automatically with a tested restore

name: Site structure
checks: Every page meant to rank is reachable within three clicks of the home page
No orphan pages: every indexable page has at least one internal link pointing to it
The main navigation is made of ordinary HTML links that work without scripts
Navigation labels are descriptive and each link's text matches the topic of its target
The header links only to priority pages
The footer carries a plain list of key pages, legal pages and contact details
Breadcrumbs are visible on every page below the home page
The breadcrumb shows the real hierarchy and matches the breadcrumb markup
URL folders mirror the site hierarchy
The page links up to its parent or hub page
At least three related pages link to this page from within their content
The page links to three to five related pages from within its content
Internal link text is descriptive, never "click here", and varies naturally
Each search is locked to one page, and every other mention of it on the site links to that page
No two pages compete for the same search
Every hub page links to all of its child pages and every child links back
On-site search, where present, works and its result pages are not indexed
The pages with the most internal links are the priority pages

name: Page titles and descriptions
checks: The page has exactly one title tag
The title is 30 to 60 characters and is not cut off in results
The title is unique across the site
The title leads with the page's assigned search
The title matches what the page actually delivers
The brand name sits at the end of the title in one consistent format
The page has exactly one meta description
The meta description is 110 to 155 characters
The meta description is unique across the site
The meta description is made of complete sentences, leads with the answer and gives a reason to click
The meta description contains the assigned search or a close variant, naturally
The title Google displays in results matches the written title
Sharing tags are set: title, description and a 1200 by 630 image
The site name and icon display correctly in search results

name: Headings and copy
checks: The page has exactly one H1
The H1 contains the assigned search or a natural paraphrase of it
Headings run in order with no level skipped
At least two or three H2s are phrased as the reader's next questions
Headings describe the content beneath them and are never used only for styling
The assigned search appears in the first 100 words
Each supporting search appears in a heading or FAQ question and in the body
No stuffing: a search term is never used three times in one paragraph and the copy reads naturally aloud
The page opens with the direct answer, not with background
Word count is within the range for its page type and never under 300 words
Reading level is grade 7 to 9 and the average sentence is under 20 words
Paragraphs are one to three sentences
Every service and sub-service the business offers on this topic is covered
At least one table or list is used where the content is tabular or step-by-step
No block of copy is shared with sibling pages beyond the agreed overlap limit
No filler phrases and no superlatives without proof
Spelling, grammar, articles and the casing of acronyms and place names are correct
No placeholder text, bracketed notes, outdated years or expired facts remain
The vocabulary is the trade's own: the words customers and practitioners really use

name: Images and media
checks: Every meaningful image has alt text and decorative images have empty alt text
Alt text describes what is actually in the image and is never a list of search terms
Image file names are descriptive and hyphenated
The page has at least one original image that is not stock
No image file is over 200 KB without a stated reason
Responsive images serve the right size for each screen
Meaningful images are real image elements, not CSS backgrounds
Videos have a title, a description and captions or a transcript
Videos never autoplay with sound and load only when needed, behind a poster image
Key images are included in the sitemap
Photos of people, premises and work are real and belong to the business
The image shown when the page is shared is set and displays correctly

name: Verified facts
checks: Organization or LocalBusiness markup is present on the home page
The organization markup's name, address, logo and contact details match the visible facts exactly
The sameAs list names every official profile and every link in it works
WebSite markup is present with the site name
Breadcrumb markup is present and matches the visible breadcrumb
Service pages carry Service markup with service type, provider and area served
Where an FAQ is shown, FAQPage markup is present and identical to the visible questions and answers
Articles carry Article markup with headline, author, published date and modified date
The author is marked up as a Person with name, page, job title and profiles
Review and rating markup is used only for real, visible reviews and within Google's rules
Where real premises exist, address, coordinates, hours and phone in the markup match the Google profile
The page passes Google's Rich Results Test with no errors
The schema validator shows no missing required properties
Markup describes only what is visible on the page
One phone format, one logo address and one business name are used in all markup
Entities are joined by identifiers: organization, website, page and author reference each other
No duplicate or conflicting markup blocks are output by plugins
Dates in the markup match the dates shown on the page
Specialised types are used where they fit: steps, video, product, event, defined term

name: AI readiness
checks: The question is the heading and a direct answer of 40 to 60 words sits directly under it
Every section opens with its own answer, so it can be quoted alone
Sections make sense out of context, with no "as mentioned above"
The follow-up questions people ask on this topic are each answered on the page
An FAQ of five to eight questions is present, each answered in 40 to 60 words
Facts are stated as plain sentences an assistant can quote: who, what, where, how much, how long
The page contains at least one original number, data point or finding, with its source
Outside facts name their source and link to it
Where people ask "best" or "versus", the page answers in a comparison or table
The page carries one quotable line from a named expert
The published date and last-reviewed date are visible
An llms.txt file exists at the root, is accurate and lists the key pages
robots.txt allows the AI crawlers the business has chosen to allow, by name
The firewall and content delivery network do not block those AI crawlers
The content is readable with JavaScript turned off
One identity sentence describes the business the same way on the site and on every profile
The About page states in plain facts who the business is, what it does, where, since when and for whom
The brand name cannot be confused with another organisation, or the difference is stated
The business's records on the sources AI draws from, such as LinkedIn, Crunchbase and Wikidata, exist and agree
The business is present on the third-party lists, directories and review sites AI cites for its trade
The business is named when the page's main question is asked in ChatGPT, recorded with the date
The business is cited when the page's main question triggers a Google AI Overview or AI Mode answer, recorded with the date
The business is named when the page's main question is asked in Perplexity and Gemini, recorded with the date
What AI assistants say about the business is checked for wrong facts, and each one is logged

name: Local signals
checks: The business name is identical on the site, the Google profile and every listing
The address is identical everywhere, including its format
The phone number is identical everywhere and is a local number where the business is local
Name, address and phone appear on the site as text, not inside an image
A contact page shows name, address, phone, hours and email
A map is embedded on the contact or location page where real premises exist
The areas served are listed on the site accurately
Each priority service area has its own page
A service-area page is at least 70% unique against its sibling area pages
A local page names real neighbourhoods, landmarks and local conditions
A local page is not a copy of another with the place name swapped
A business with several locations has one page per location, each with its own details
The business is listed on Apple Business Connect and Bing Places
The business is listed on Yelp, Facebook and the main general directories
The business is listed on the directories specific to its trade
The business is listed with its local chamber of commerce and trade associations
No duplicate listings exist on any platform
No listing shows an old name, address or phone number
Listing categories are consistent from platform to platform
The website address on every listing is correct and uses https
Local pages carry the place name in the title, H1 and copy, naturally
Directions, parking or service radius are explained where customers need them
Call tracking uses number swapping on the site only, so listed numbers stay consistent
Local press, sponsorships and partners mention or link to the business
No virtual office or false address is used anywhere

name: Google Business Profile
checks: The profile is claimed and verified
The profile is owned by the business's own account, with correct access roles
The profile name is the real business name with no added search terms
The primary category is the most specific correct one
Secondary categories are complete and accurate
The address or service-area setting is correct, with the address hidden for service-area businesses
Phone and website are correct, and the website link carries a tracking tag
Regular and holiday hours are set
The business description is complete and accurate
Every service is listed with a description
Products or a menu are listed where they apply
All relevant attributes are filled in
Logo and cover photo are set
At least ten real photos are present and new ones are added every month
Posts go out at the agreed cadence and the latest is under seven days old
A booking or appointment link is set
Customer questions on the profile are answered, and common ones are covered in the description and posts
No duplicate profile exists and none is suspended
Profile facts match the website and its markup
Calls, direction requests, website clicks and searches are recorded monthly

name: Reviews and reputation
checks: The Google review count is at or above the middle of the top three local competitors
The average Google rating is 4.5 or higher
At least one new review arrived in the last 30 days
Reviews arrive steadily, not in bursts
Every review has a reply within two working days, and critical ones are answered professionally
Reviews exist on at least two other platforms that matter for the trade
A review request goes out after every job, with no filtering of unhappy customers and no rewards
Reviews mention services and places in the customers' own words
Real reviews are shown on the site with their source
No fake reviews exist, and a search for the brand shows no unanswered complaint on page one

name: Conversion elements
checks: The page has one primary call to action, the same one throughout
The call to action is visible without scrolling
The call to action repeats after the proof section and at the end of the page
The call-to-action wording says exactly what happens next
The phone number is in the header and tappable
The form asks only for what is needed
A test submission arrives, and the sender sees a confirmation
Form errors are clear and tell the visitor how to fix them
The confirmation says what happens next and when
A person answers each new lead within the agreed time, tested with a real enquiry
Licences, insurance, certifications or guarantees are shown near the call to action
Real reviews or testimonials are on the page
Proof is shown: results, examples or numbers, each with a source
A lighter second step is offered to visitors not ready to talk
The chat widget works, is answered and covers no content
The booking link works from first click to confirmed appointment
Within five seconds a visitor can tell what is offered, for whom and where
Pricing or honest price guidance is present
The page answers the usual objections: cost, time and risk
The page has no dead end: every section leads to a next step
No competing actions or pop-ups pull the visitor from the primary action
The offer or commitment that removes the visitor's risk is stated

name: Tracking and measurement
checks: Google Analytics 4 is installed once on every page
Key events are set in Analytics: form, call, booking and chat
Search Console is verified for the whole domain, with owner access held by the business
Call tracking is in place and names the source of each call
Every form submission records the page it came from
Every booking records the page it came from
Office traffic and bots are filtered out of the data
The consent banner and consent mode are set so data is lawful and complete
Links from the profile, social posts and email carry a consistent tracking tag
Visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot are separated out in Analytics
Position and AI-mention tracking is set up for the mapped searches, with a starting baseline

name: Content inventory
checks: Every URL on the site is listed in one inventory
Each page has a stated purpose and reader
Each page has one assigned search
Each page has a status: keep, fix, merge or remove
Thin, outdated and duplicate pages are identified
Pages that already hold rankings, traffic or links are marked protected before any change
Mapped searches with no page are listed as gaps
Every page to be merged or removed has a redirect target

name: Off-site presence
checks: A search for the brand shows the business's own properties across page one
Relevant industry sites mention the business, counted against competitors
Real, relevant sites link to the business, counted against the top three competitors
No spam, paid or manipulative link patterns point at the site
The wording of links pointing at the site looks natural
The business earned press or editorial mentions in the last 12 months
Profiles on the platforms that matter for the trade are claimed and complete
Facts are identical on every profile
No duplicate or abandoned profiles exist
Mentions of the brand without a link are identified
The business appears on the lists and comparison pages that rank for "best" searches in its trade and area
The business is present where customers ask: Reddit, Quora and trade forums

name: Social presence
checks: The right channels for the trade are identified and claimed
Handles match the brand on every channel
Each profile is complete: description, link, contact, category and images
Facts on each profile match the site
The posting cadence is met and the last post is under 14 days old
Posts are original and show real work and real people
The site links to each profile and each profile links to the site
Each key page on the site has been shared on the channels

name: Search map coverage
checks: Every service in every area served is mapped to the searches customers use for it
Hiring searches are mapped: the words used when someone is ready to buy
Outcome searches are mapped: the results customers ask for in their own words
Problem searches are mapped: "why is" and "how do I fix"
Switching searches are mapped: alternatives to a current provider or platform
AI prompts are mapped: the full sentences people type into assistants
Spoken and "near me" forms are mapped
Searches in other languages are mapped where customers use them
Each mapped search is assigned to exactly one page
Each mapped search carries dated evidence that people really make it
The map is compared with Search Console queries every 30 days and new searches are added

name: Uniqueness and information gain
checks: The page contains at least one fact or number available nowhere else
The page contains at least one first-hand finding from real work
The named author states a clear position or verdict
A local page carries three facts true only for that place and trade
Overlap with every other page on the site is under 25%, measured by script
The page would be wrong if the place or trade name were swapped
The page says something the three top-ranking pages do not, and the gap is noted
The page has an original chart, table, photo or diagram
The page gives steps the reader can carry out themselves
No text is copied from elsewhere on the web
The FAQ set is not reused on any other page

name: Fact integrity
checks: Every number traces to an entry in the fact register with its source
Company facts match the fact register exactly
No invented reviews, awards, clients or team members appear
Results are stated as counts with their definition
Outside facts were confirmed at the original source, with the date checked
Quotes are real and approved by the person quoted
Prices, timeframes and guarantees match what the business really offers
Regulated claims follow the rules of the field: legal, medical, financial
A named person signed the fact-check sheet before publishing

name: Author and entity
checks: A named author is shown on the page
The author has a page with experience, credentials and a photo
The author's outside profiles are consistent and linked
The author's expertise fits the topic
Health, legal and money topics show a qualified reviewer
The site publishes how its content is written and checked
Ownership, leadership and location are stated openly
Phone, email and address are real and answered
Privacy policy, terms and required legal pages are present and current
Licences, memberships and awards shown are current and can be checked with the issuer
Named methods and terms are defined on their own page with defined-term markup
Asking AI assistants about the brand and the author returns an accurate description

name: AI answer verification
checks: A prompt set is defined: at least ten real prompts for each service and area
Every prompt is run in ChatGPT and the answer recorded
Every prompt is run in Gemini and the answer recorded
Every prompt is run in Perplexity and the answer recorded
Every prompt is checked in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode and the answer recorded
Every prompt is run in Microsoft Copilot and the answer recorded
Every prompt is run in the sixth engine of the AI Score set and the answer recorded
Each prompt is run at least three times per engine and the share of runs naming the business is recorded
The position in each answer is recorded: named first, listed or absent
The sources each engine cites are recorded, and the business is present on them
The competitors each engine names are recorded
What each engine says about the business is factually right
Each engine's description of the business matches how the business presents itself
Citation links point to the right page
Raw answers are archived with their date
The change from the previous month is reported

name: Accessibility
checks: Text contrast is at least 4.5 to 1
Every function works from the keyboard alone
Every form field has a label and errors are announced
Page regions use proper landmarks and semantic elements
Link text makes sense out of context
No information is carried by colour alone
Text can be enlarged to 200% without loss of content
Motion and autoplay can be paused and reduced-motion settings are respected
An automated scan shows no critical errors and a screen-reader pass was done on the template

name: Video and visual search
checks: A YouTube channel is claimed, branded and linked to the site
A video exists for each priority service or question
Video titles and descriptions match mapped searches and use chapters
Each video is embedded on its matching page with video markup
Short versions are published on the short-video platforms
Original photos of real work carry enough context to appear in image and lens searches

name: Freshness and corrections
checks: The page shows its last review date and reviewer
Each page type has a review cycle and no page is past it
Time-sensitive facts are flagged for re-checking: prices, laws, product names, years
After each search-system update, affected pages are reviewed within 14 days
A public record lists corrections made
Dated predictions are revisited and marked right or wrong
Outdated pages are updated, merged or removed, never left standing
The modified date changes only when the content really changes

name: Publishing readiness
checks: The page passed every applicable check and the result is recorded
A second, independent reviewer signed it off
The owner approved it where the rules require approval
Its internal links in and out are placed at publish, so it never launches as an orphan
It is added to the sitemap and indexing is requested
The live page is fetched and checked again after publishing
It is recorded in the work log with a day-seven indexing check
